prospector.name: Dez Okafor
prospector.personality: Keeps to the same stretch of rock, hauls it in, does it again.

prospector_2.name: Iris Vandenberg
prospector_2.personality: Cautious - gives every rock a wide berth before ever lining up a shot.

prospector_3.name: Boone Achebe
prospector_3.personality: Pushes in close and doesn't back off easy.

pirate_lurker.name: Redtooth
pirate_lurker.personality: Doesn't say much unless there's a toll to collect.

demand.text: That's far enough. This stretch of the belt is mine - pay a 300cr toll and you keep flying. Try me and find out what happens instead.

paid.text: Pleasure doing business. Don't let me catch you out here again.

one_way_hail.message: That's close enough, hauler. This stretch of the belt costs a toll - hail me and we'll talk terms, or keep pushing your luck.

wreck_raider.name: Scrap-tooth
wreck_raider.personality: Was hiding in the wreck's hold the whole time, and doesn't wait to talk.
